svg.text: The mark joins Clauto’s initial with the act of revising a cut.
The diagonal seam carries into document corners and editing tools.
Pure geometry. No textures, stock artwork, or platform symbols.
Drawn to work at 16, 20, and 24 pixels
24-unit grid · 1.7-unit square stroke · editable SVG + SwiftUI paths
Original Clauto artwork · Source and reproduction instructions: Design/Identity/PROVENANCE.md
